reading.zh: 严格按顺序的五步：先由护栏拒绍不安全的目录布局，再规划依赖（每个只要一份），然后解出最终激活集（同角色互斥），顺带收编手动放的 Mod，**最后**才写中转树。
reading.en: Five steps in strict order: the guard refuses unsafe layouts first, then dependencies are planned (one copy each), then the active set is resolved (same-character exclusivity), hand-placed mods are adopted, and only then is the staging tree written.
